_comment: Rendering parity manifest (M30) — list of scenarios the harness
loads, captures and SSIM-compares against a baseline. Each entry:
name        unique slug (used for the captured PNG filename)
baseline    relative path under baselines/ for the reference PNG
atmospheric true → use the looser 0.85 SSIM threshold (cloud /
threshold   override the per-class default if needed.
Baselines marked with empty (0-byte) files are placeholders for
future captures — the harness records them as 'skipped' rather
than failing. Drop a real PNG into baselines/<file> to start
